I have a somewhat ambitious project: make a 15-year-old Python web framework significantly faster.
No rewrite, Not replacing the ERP, Not migrate the application to another framework, not just incremental improvements.


We make an app on top of Frappe framework and its rather basic but its somehow bogged down, Our application isn't particularly exotic or complicated like HRIS or ERP, it's mostly CRUD with mobile client



The first thing I did was benchmark Gunicorn and current production setup.

we limit to 4 cpu out of 6 physical core, 12 threads



we also check mariadb, its not DB, and python code is not heavy compute either, so where the bottleneck?


So we check: https://github.com/emmett-framework/granian/blob/master/benchmarks/vs.md

the improvement from Gunicorn WSGI to Granian WSGI is 

Granian Wsgi get 10KB (c64)	1258541	125824	0.507ms	25.507ms
Granian Wsgi echo 10KB (iter) (c64)	1081157	108084	0.589ms	34.131ms

Gunicorn Gthread get 10KB (c64)	91704	9175	6.963ms	39.026ms
Gunicorn Gthread echo 10KB (iter) (c64)	67395	6744	9.479ms	27.452ms

9k to 125k RPS, so free performance I thought
